###################################################
###################################################
###### Idea Variation 2 GA Idea Groups Dip
###################################################
###################################################

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_1
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_1 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_1 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_1_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_1
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_1
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_1
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### National Idea Level 2 dip_1_1
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_1_1 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_1_1 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_1 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_1
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_1 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_1_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_1_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_1
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_3
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_3 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_3_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_3_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_3
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_4
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_4 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_4 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_4_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_4_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_4_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_4 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_4 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_4_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_4
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_4
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_4
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_5_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_5
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_5 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_5_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_5_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_5
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_6
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_6 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_6 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_6_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_6_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_6_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_6 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_6 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_6_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_6
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_6
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_6
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_7_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_7_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_7
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_8
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_8 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_8 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_8_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_8
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_8
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_8
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_8
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_8 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_8_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_8_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_8
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_10
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_10 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_10_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_10_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_10
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_11
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_11 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_11 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_11_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_11_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_11_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_11 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_11 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_11_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_11
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_11
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_11
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_12
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_12 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_12_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_12_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_12
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_13
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_13 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_13 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_13_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_13_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_13_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_13 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_13 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_13_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_13
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_13
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_13
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_14_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_14_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_14_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_14_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_14_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_14
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_15
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_15 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_15 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_15_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_15
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_15
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_15
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_15
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_15 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_15_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_15_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_15
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_17
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_17
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_17
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_17 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_17_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_17_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_17
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_18
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_18 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_18 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_18_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_18_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_18_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_18 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_18 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_18_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_18
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_18
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_18
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_19
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_19 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_19_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_19_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_19
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_20
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_20 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_20 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_20_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_20_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_20_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_20 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_20 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_20_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_20
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_20
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_20
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_21_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_21_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_21
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_22
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_22 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_22 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_22_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_22_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_22_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_22 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_22 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_22_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_22
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_22
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_22
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_24 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_24_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_24
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_24
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_24
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_24
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_24 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_24_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_24_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_24
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_26
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_26 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_26_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_26_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_26
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_27
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_27 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_27 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_27_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_27_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_27_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_27 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_27 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_27_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_27
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_27
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_27
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_28
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_28 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_28_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_28_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_28
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_29
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_29 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_29 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_29_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_29_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_29_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_29 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_29 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_29_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_29
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_29
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_29
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_31
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_31 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_31 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_31_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_31
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_31
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_31
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_31
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_31 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_31_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_31_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_31
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_33
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_33 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_33_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_33_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_33
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_34
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_34 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_34 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_34_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_34_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_34_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_34 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_34 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_34_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_34
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_34
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_34
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	ai_will_do = {

			value = 1000
		}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_35
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_35 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_35_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_35_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_35
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_36
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_36 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_36 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_36_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_36_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_36_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_36 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_36 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_36_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_36
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_36
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_36
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_37_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_37
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_38
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_38 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_38 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_38_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_38
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_38
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_38
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
