###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_38
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_38 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_38_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_38_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_38
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################

###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_40_1 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_40_1 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_1 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_40
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_40 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_40_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_40_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_40
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_41
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_41 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_41 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_41_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_41_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_41_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_41 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_41 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_41_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_41
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_41
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_41
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_42
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_42 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_42_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_42_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_42
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_43
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_43 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_43 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_43_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_43_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_43_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_43 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_43 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_43_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_43
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_43
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_43
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_44_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_44_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_44_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_44_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_44_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_44
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_45
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_45 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_45 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_45_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_45
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_45
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_45
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_45
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_45 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_45_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_45_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_45
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_47
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_47 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_47_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_47_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_47
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_48
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_48 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_48 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_48_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_48_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_48_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_48 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_48 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_48_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_48
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_48
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_48
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_1

			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_49
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_49 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_49_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_49_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_49
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_50
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_50 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_50 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_50_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_50_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_50_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_50 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_50 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_50_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_50
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_50
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_50
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_51_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_51_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_51
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_52
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_52 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_52 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_52_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_52
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_52
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_52
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_52 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {

				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip

					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}

					limit = {

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_52_3

			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_54 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_54_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_54
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_54
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_54
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_54
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_54 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_54_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_54_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_54
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_56_2 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_1
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_56_2 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_2 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_56
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_56 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_56_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_56_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_56
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_57
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_57 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_57 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_57_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_57_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_57_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_57 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_57 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_57_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_57
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_57
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_57
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_58
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_58 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_58_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_58_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_58
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_59
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_59 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_59 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_59_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_59_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_59_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_59 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_59 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_59_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_59
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_59
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_59
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_61 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_61_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_61
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_61
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_61
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_61
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_61 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_61_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_61_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_61
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_63
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_63 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_63_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_63_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_63
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_64
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_64 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_64 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_64_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_64_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_64_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_64 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_64 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_64_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_64
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_64
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_64
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_65
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_65 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_65_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_65_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_65
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_66
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_66 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_66 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_66_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_66_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_66_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_66 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_66 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_66_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_66
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_66
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_66
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_68
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_68 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_68 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_68_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_68
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_68
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_68
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_68
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_68 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_68_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_68_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_68
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_70
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_70 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_70_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_70_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_70
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_71
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_71 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_71 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_71_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_71_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_71_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_71 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_71 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_71_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_71
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_71
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_71
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_72_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_72
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_72 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_72_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_72_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_72
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_73
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_73 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_73 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_73_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_73_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_73_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_73 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_73 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_73_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_73
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_73
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_73
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_74_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_74_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_74_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_74
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_75
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_75 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_75 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_75_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_75
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_75
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_75
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
