###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_75
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_75 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_75_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_75_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_75
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_77
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_77 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_77_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_77_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_77
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_78
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_78 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_78 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_78_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_78_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_78_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_78 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_78 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_78_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_78
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_78
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_78
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_79
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_79 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_79_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_79_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_79
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_80
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_80 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_80 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_80_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_80_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_80_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_80 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_80 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_80_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_80
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_80
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_80
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_81_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_81_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_81

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_82
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_82 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_82 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_82_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_82
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_82
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_82
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_82_2

					change_variable = {

	ai_will_do = {

			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {

					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84

				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_84_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_84
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_84
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_84
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip

					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_84
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_84 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_84_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_84_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_84
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Select National Idea dip_85

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_85 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_85 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_85_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_85_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_85_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_85 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_85 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_85_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_85
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_85
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_85
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_86
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_86 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_86_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_86_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_86
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_87
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_87 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_87 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_87_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_87_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_87_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_87 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_87 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_87_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_87
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_87
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_87
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_88_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_88_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_88
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_89
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_89 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_89 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_89_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_89_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_89_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_89 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_89 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_89_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_89
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_89
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_89
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_91 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_91_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_91
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_91
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_91
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_91
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_91 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_91_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_91_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_91
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_93
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_93 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_93_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_93_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_93
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_94
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_94 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_94 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_94_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_94_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_94_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_94 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_94 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_94_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_94
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_94
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_94
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_95
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_95 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_95_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_95_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_95
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_96
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_96 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_96 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_96_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_96_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_96_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_96 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_96 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_96_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_96
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_96
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_96
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_97_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_97
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_98
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_98 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_98 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_98_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_98
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_98
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_98
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_98
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_98 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_98_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_98_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_98
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_100
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_100 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_100_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_100_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_100
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_101
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_101 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_101 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_101_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_101_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_101_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_101 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_101 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_101_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_101
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_101
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_101
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_102_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_102
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_102 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_102_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_102_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_102
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_103
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_103 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_103 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_103_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_103_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_103_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_103 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_103 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_103_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_103
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_103
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_103
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_104_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_104_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_104_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_104
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_105
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_105 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_105 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_105_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_105
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_105
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_105
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_105
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_105 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_105_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_105_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_105
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_107
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_107 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_107_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_107_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_107
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_108
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_108 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_108 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_108_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_108_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_108_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_108 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_108 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_108_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_108
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_108
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_108
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_109
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_109 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_109_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_109_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_109
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_110
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_110 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_110 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_110_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_110_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_110_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_110 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_110 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_110_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_110
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_110
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_110
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_111_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_111_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_111_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_111_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_111_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_111_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_111

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_112
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_112 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_112 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_112_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_112
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_112
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_112
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_112 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_112_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip

			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_112_1

					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_112

				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_114_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_114
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_114
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_114
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
