###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_114
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_114 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_114_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_114_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_114
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_115
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_115 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_115 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_115_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_115_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_115_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_115 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_115 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_115_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_115
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_115
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_115
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_116
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_116 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_116_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_116_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_116
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_117
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_117 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_117 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_117_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_117_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_117_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_117 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_117 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_117_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_117
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_117
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_117
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_118_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_118_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_118
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_119
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_119 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_119 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_119_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_119_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_119_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_119 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_119 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_119_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_119
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_119
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_119
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_121 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_121_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_121
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_121
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_121
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_121
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_121 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_121_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_121_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_121
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_123
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_123 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_123_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_123_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_123
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_124
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_124 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_124 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_124_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_124_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_124_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_124 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_124 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_124_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_124
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_124
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_124
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_125
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_125 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_125_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_125_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_125
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_126
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_126 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_126 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_126_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_126_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_126_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_126 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_126 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_126_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_126
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_126
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_126
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_127

					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_128
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_128 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_128 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_128_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_128
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_128
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_128
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_128
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_128 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_128_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_128_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_128
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_130
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_130 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_130_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_130_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_130
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_131
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_131 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_131 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_131_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_131_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_131_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_131 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_131 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_131_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_131
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_131
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_131
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_133
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_133
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}

				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_133_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_133

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_134
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_134 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_134 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_134_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_134
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_134
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_134
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_134
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_134 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_134_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_134_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_134
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_136
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_136 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_136_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_136_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_136
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_137
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_137 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_137 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_137_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_137_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_137_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_137 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_137 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_137_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_137
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_137
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_137
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_138
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_138 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_138_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_138_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_138
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_139
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_139 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_139 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_139_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_139_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_139_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_139 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_139 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_139_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_139
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_139
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_139
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_140_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_140_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_140_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_140_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_140_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_140
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_141
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_141 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_141 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_141_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_141
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_141
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_141
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_141
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_141 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_141_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_141_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_141
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_143
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_143
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_143
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_143 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_143_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_143_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_143
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_144
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_144 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_144 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_144_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_144_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_144_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_144 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_144 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_144_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_144
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_144
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_144
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_145
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_145 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_145_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_145_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_145
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_146
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_146 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_146 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_146_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_146_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_146_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_146 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_146 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_146_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_146
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_146
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_146
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_147_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_147_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_147
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_148
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_148 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_148 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_148_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_148_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_148_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_148 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_148 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_148_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_148
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_148
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_148
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_150 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_150_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_150
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_150
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_150
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_150
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_150 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_150_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_150_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_150
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_152
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_152 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_152_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_152_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_152
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_153
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_153 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_153 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_153_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_153_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_153_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_153 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_153 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_153_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_153
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_153
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_153
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
