			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_154
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_154 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_154_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_154_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_154
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_155
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_155 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_155 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_155_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_155_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_155_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_155 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_155 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_155_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_155
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_155
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_155
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_157
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_157 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_157 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_157_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_157
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_157
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_157
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_157
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_157 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_157_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_157_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_157
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_159
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_159 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_159_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_159_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_159
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_160
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_160 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_160 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_160_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_160_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_160_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_160 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_160 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_160_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_160
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_160
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_160
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_161
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_161 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_161_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_161_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_161
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_162
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_162 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_162 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_162_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_162_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_162_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_162 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_162 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_162_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_162
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_162
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_162
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_163_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_163
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_164
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_164 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_164 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_164_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_164
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_164
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_164
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_164
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_164 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_164_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_164_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_164
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_166_1 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_166_1 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_1 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_166
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_166 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_166_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_166_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_166
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_167
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_167 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_167 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_167_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_167_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_167_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_167 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_167 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_167_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_167
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_167
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_167
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_168
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_168 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_168_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_168_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_168
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_169
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_169 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_169 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_169_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_169_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_169_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_169 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_169 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_169_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_169
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_169
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_169
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_170_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_170_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_170_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_170_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_170_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_170
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_171
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_171 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_171 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_171_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_171
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_171
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_171
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_171
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_171 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_171_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_171_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_171
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_173
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_173 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_173_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_173_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_173
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_174
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_174 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_174 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_174_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_174_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_174_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_174 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_174 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_174_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_174
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_174
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_174
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_1

			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_175
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_175 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_175_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_175_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_175
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_176
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_176 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_176 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_176_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_176_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_176_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_176 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_176 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_176_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_176
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_176
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_176
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_177_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_177_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_177

				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_178
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_178 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_178 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_178_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_178
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_178
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_178
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_2

			}		
		}
	}

					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178

					}

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_178_3

			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_180 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_180_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_180
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_180
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_180
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_180
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_180 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_180_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_180_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_180
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Select National Idea dip_181

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_181_2 }

			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}

			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current

		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {

			value = 1000

				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_181 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_181_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_181
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_181
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_181
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip

				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase

			}
		}
	}

###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_182_2 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_1
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_182_2 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_2 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_182
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_182 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_182_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_182_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_182
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea dip_183
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_dip_183 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_183 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_183_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_183_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_183_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_dip
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_dip >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_dip_183 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_183 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_183_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_dip_183
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_183
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_183
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_dip
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_dip
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea dip_184
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_dip_184 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_dip
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_dip_184_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_dip
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_dip_184_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_dip_184
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
